item.title: Goolsbee de la Fed dice está claro "lo que tiene que pasar" si la inflación no cede
item.description: El presidente de la Fed de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, afirmó que está abierto a la posibilidad de que la inflación comience a descender hasta el objetivo del 2%, pero que, si eso no ocurre, será necesario subir las tasas de interés.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: El presidente de la Fed de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, afirmó que está abierto a la posibilidad de que la inflación comience a descender hasta el objetivo del 2%, pero que, si eso no ocurre, será necesario subir las tasas de interés. "En este momento, no tenemos un problema de empleo, pero sí tenemos un problema de inflación", afirmó Goolsbee. "Estoy dispuesto a aceptar que se me demuestre que el problema de inflación que tenemos no es un problema persistente, sino que se debe a una perturbación en la oferta que va a desaparecer. Pero quiero ver pruebas de que está desapareciendo. De lo contrario, sabemos lo que tiene que pasar".

item.title: Erosion of Germany's political centre exposes Merz's weakening grip on power
item.description: Germany's far right and far left both made big gains in Sunday's state elections, exposing yet again the erosion of the political centre in Europe's largest economy as well as Chancellor Friedrich Merz's weakening hold on power.
item.dc:creator: James Mackenzie
item.content:encoded: Germany's far right and far left both made big gains in Sunday's [USN:L1N45C01D TEXT:"state elections"], exposing yet again the erosion of the political centre in Europe's largest economy as well as Chancellor Friedrich Merz's weakening hold on power. The anti-immigration Alternative for Germany (AfD) confirmed its strength in the formerly communist eastern states by taking first place in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania state, building on its [USN:L1N44Y01V TEXT:"triumph"] two weeks ago in Saxony-Anhalt. The AfD also recorded its best-ever result in Berlin, where the far-left Left Party came first and looks set to replace Merz's conservative Christian Democrats (CDU) in the mayor's office. Merz called the result in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania — the worst in CDU history — "a disaster". But he defied speculation he might step down, pledging to remain to pass a package of tax and pension reforms that he hopes will help revive Germany's sluggish economy. For now, at least, the party has stood behind him, although the result will add to pressure within his coalition with the centre-left Social Democrats (SPD), some of whom want to water down parts of the reform agenda. "We have to analyse, as a government, why there is this sense of uncertainty in the country," SPD co-leader Lars Klingbeil said. A pervasive sense of economic malaise and disillusion with traditional political parties point to further turbulence ahead, with a raft of state elections in western Germany due next year. "Germany is entering a period of political instability where viable coalitions are harder and harder to build, and that doesn't bode well for Europe when Germany is the de facto leader," said Sudha David-Wilp, a senior fellow at the German Marshall Fund of the United States. The AfD wants to expel foreigners with no right to stay in Germany, restore energy ties with Russia and quit the euro, while the Left Party wants to cap rents and nationalise large parts of the Berlin housing market. By contrast, Merz's pursuit of what he says are painful but necessary reforms has yet to yield improvements that voters can feel. "We can see how difficult it is to win people over while in government and from the centre of society," said Stefan Evers, the CDU's lead candidate in Berlin. DISASTER Even [USN:L8N3WN0O8 TEXT:"before the election"], Merz's approval ratings were at a record low and his party has trailed the AfD in national polling for months. "People would tell us that as long as he had a say in things, we wouldn't vote for you," said one CDU election campaigner in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. From the start of his time in office, when a normally routine parliamentary vote to confirm him as chancellor turned into a [USN:L6N3RE0KX TEXT:"humiliation"] requiring a second round of voting, Merz has struggled to establish his authority. There have been repeated gaffes, from saying people in Germany needed to work longer hours to identifying as "middle class" while working as a highly remunerated board member of BlackRock Asset Management. Surveys indicate that his communication lapses and his difficulty in establishing an emotional connection with voters anxious about their economic future both contributed to the outcome of all five state elections this year. But Germany's deep-seated economic challenges — an ageing population, poor growth and the erosion of its industrial base under increasing pressure from China — resist easy solutions. The reforms themselves caused problems in formerly communist eastern Germany, where despite more than three decades of economic transformation, more voters than in the west earn the minimum wage and rely completely on the state pension in retirement. Manuela Schwesig, the SPD state premier of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, whose success in limiting the AfD's gains in her state was one of the few bright spots for the government, said she was "surprised" by Merz's refusal to change course. Her campaign was heavily critical of Merz, whom she accused of showing indifference towards voters struggling with soaring fuel prices. She also called for changes to the pension reform that would require people to work for longer — a particularly unpopular issue in the east, where many have not built up the same level of savings as those in the west. FIREWALL UNDER PRESSURE Days before the vote, as speculation grew that his position might be in danger, [USN:S8N4130DH TEXT:"senior CDU leaders"] rallied around the chancellor, aware that replacing him would put the reform programme at risk without solving underlying problems. So far, the policy — known as the 'firewall' — under which the mainstream parties refuse to cooperate with the AfD has kept it from sharing power. But there are growing doubts about whether it is possible to exclude a party which enjoys the support of more voters in Germany than any other. Despite reservations about cooperating with a party with elements that are classified by the domestic security services as extremist right-wing, there are growing calls in the CDU for a rethink. "This 'firewall' hasn't done anything for the CDU and they need to think about that," said Leif-Erik Holm, the AfD's lead candidate in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. Opinion polls have shown deep disillusion among many voters with a political system that has seen a succession of coalitions between the formerly fiercely antagonistic mainstream parties of the centre-right and centre-left. Under former Chancellor Angela Merkel, the "grand coalition" of CDU and SPD, seen only once before at federal level during the 1960s, became standard. Merz, once seen as a firebrand conservative, repeated the exercise after another coalition, headed by SPD Chancellor Olaf Scholz, collapsed in 2024. "It's just allowed a vacuum on the right and the left for these parties to emerge," David-Wilp said.

item.title: Dinamarca diz que Otan compartilha responsabilidade pela segurança do Ártico em acordo sobre Groenlândia
item.description: Dinamarca, Groenlândia e Estados Unidos vão assinar na terça-feira um acordo sobre a segurança da Groenlândia — acordo que, segundo a Dinamarca, colocará a segurança do Ártico sob a supervisão da Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), em vez de deixá-la exclusivamente a cargo de Washington e Copenhague.
item.dc:creator: Stine Jacobsen, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
item.content:encoded: Dinamarca, Groenlândia e Estados Unidos vão assinar na terça-feira um acordo sobre a segurança da Groenlândia — acordo que, segundo a Dinamarca, colocará a segurança do Ártico sob a supervisão da Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), em vez de deixá-la exclusivamente a cargo de Washington e Copenhague. O acordo, que deve ser assinado na Assembleia Geral da Organização das Nações Unidas em Nova York na terça-feira, ainda não foi divulgado, embora o presidente Donald Trump tenha afirmado que ele concede aos EUA “controle permanente”. Dinamarca e Groenlândia não se pronunciaram sobre a afirmação de Trump, mas disseram que o acordo beneficiará a ilha ártica e respeitará sua soberania. O acordo surge após meses de pressão por parte de Trump, que tem dito que os Estados Unidos deveriam controlar a Groenlândia e, em algumas ocasiões, se recusou a descartar o uso de força militar ou econômica para adquirir o território dinamarquês semiautônomo. Suas ameaças, que atingiram o auge em janeiro, desencadearam uma crise diplomática dentro da Otan e levaram a Dinamarca e a Groenlândia a negociar com Washington com o objetivo de amenizar a pressão. “Ele (o acordo) terá uma forma em que a responsabilidade pela segurança no Ártico não será apenas dinamarquesa ou americana”, disse o ministro das Relações Exteriores da Dinamarca, Lars Lokke Rasmussen, à emissora nacional TV2 no domingo. Ele acrescentou que, em grande medida, “seria a Otan que cuidaria do Ártico”. Um porta-voz da Otan afirmou no sábado que a aliança saudava o acordo, que “ajudará a promover a segurança, a estabilidade e a cooperação nessa região vital”. Rasmussen, que viajou para Nova York durante a madrugada, recusou-se a discutir o conteúdo do acordo. “Mas já dissemos desde o início que estamos abertos a atender aos interesses legítimos de segurança dos Estados Unidos”, declarou Rasmussen à agência de notícias dinamarquesa Ritzau na segunda-feira.

item.title: Brazil economists cut end-2026 interest rate forecast to 13.50%
item.description: Private-sector economists polled weekly by Brazil's central bank lowered their estimate for the country's benchmark interest rate at the end of 2026, now expecting one additional 25-basis-point cut.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Private-sector economists polled weekly by Brazil's central bank lowered their estimate for the country's benchmark interest rate at the end of 2026, now expecting one additional 25-basis-point cut. According to the Focus survey published on Monday, they now forecast the key Selic rate to end the year at 13.50%, down from 13.75% in the previous poll. The central bank last week cut interest rates by 25 basis points [USN:L6N458186 TEXT:"for a fifth straight meeting"], to 13.75%, and kept its options open ahead of next month's presidential election. Latin America's largest economy has been showing [USN:L1N44T0HA TEXT:"firmer signs of a slowdown"], while [USN:L1N4530DY TEXT:"inflation has eased"]. Economists kept their end-2027 Selic forecast at 12%. IPCA inflation index seen ending 2026 at 4.92%, up from previous estimate of 4.90%; end-2027 inflation forecast unchanged at 4.30%. Brazil's central bank targets inflation at 3%, plus or minus 1.5 percentage points.

item.title: Hutíes buscan avances en Yemen, mientras se informa de suspensión de ataques aéreos de Trump
item.description: Los combatientes hutíes presionaban el lunes para hacerse con el control de las alturas estratégicas de Yemen con el fin de aislar la costa del mar Rojo de las zonas que aún controlan las fuerzas respaldadas por Arabia Saudita, tras conocerse la noticia de que el presidente Donald Trump canceló los ataques estadounidenses contra el grupo.
item.dc:creator: Mohammed Ghobari, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: Los combatientes hutíes presionaban el lunes para hacerse con el control de las alturas estratégicas de Yemen con el fin de aislar la costa del mar Rojo de las zonas que aún controlan las fuerzas respaldadas por Arabia Saudita, tras conocerse la noticia de que el presidente Donald Trump canceló los ataques estadounidenses contra el grupo. El rápido avance de este grupo respaldado por Irán este mes ha extendido el conflicto de Oriente Medio a un nuevo escenario y ha supuesto una amenaza aún mayor para el suministro energético mundial. Hasta ahora, Washington ha rechazado las reiteradas peticiones del príncipe heredero de Arabia Saudita, Mohammed bin Salman, para unirse a la lucha en Yemen. Los hutíes afirmaron el sábado que habían disparado contra Riad, donde se escucharon fuertes estruendos seguidos de columnas de humo visibles cerca del aeropuerto. Arabia Saudita no se ha pronunciado sobre los primeros ataques aparentes contra la capital desde que comenzó la escalada. The New York Times informó de que la Administración Trump se había preparado el domingo para lanzar ataques aéreos contra los hutíes tras nuevas peticiones de Riad. Sin embargo, el diario señaló que Trump canceló la ofensiva en el último momento, cuando las tropas ya estaban cargando bombas en los aviones. Reuters no pudo verificar de inmediato la información y el Mando Central del ejército estadounidense no respondió a un correo electrónico en el que se le pedía una declaración. COMBATES EN LAS TIERRAS ALTAS Los hutíes, que controlan la capital de Yemen desde 2014, se hicieron este mes con la costa del mar Rojo del país en un avance relámpago que puso en fuga a las fuerzas del Gobierno yemení reconocido internacionalmente, respaldado por Arabia Saudita y con sede en el sur. Según los hutíes, Riad ha lanzado en los últimos días cientos de ataques aéreos contra las posiciones de los combatientes en las tierras altas. Sin embargo, la ventaja aérea ha servido hasta ahora de poco para frenar el avance de los combatientes, ya que las fuerzas gubernamentales respaldadas por Arabia Saudita se han desmoronado. Según Naciones Unidas, casi 700 personas han perdido la vida y miles han resultado heridas en el recrudecimiento de los combates. Más de 120.000 personas han huido de sus hogares dentro de Yemen, y miles más han huido en barco a través del mar Rojo hacia África. Cinco fuentes militares yemeníes han declarado a Reuters que los hutíes intentan ahora hacerse con unas elevaciones estratégicas, conocidas como las montañas de Kahboub, en dos provincias, Taiz y Lahij, que separan la costa del mar Rojo del sur, controlado por el Gobierno. Los combates se han centrado en las afueras del remoto distrito montañoso de Al-Wazi'iyah, en la provincia de Taiz, y en Ras al-Ara, a lo largo de la costa del océano Índico, entre la boca del mar Rojo —que los combatientes capturaron la semana pasada— y la base del Gobierno en Adén. El objetivo hutí es asegurar la retaguardia de sus fuerzas en torno al estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, que da acceso al mar Rojo, tomando el control de las alturas, lo que les permitiría abrir nuevos frentes, según las fuentes. Esto contribuiría a proteger las posiciones expuestas capturadas durante su avance en torno a Dhubab, en el mar Rojo, y en la isla de Perim, en el estrecho. EXPORTACIONES PETROLERA SAUDÍES La intensificación de los combates entre Arabia Saudita y los hutíes plantea un nuevo dilema a Trump, que se ve presionado para ayudar a defender a los estrechos aliados de Washington, pero que teme ampliar aún más la impopular guerra que lanzó en febrero contra Irán. Estados Unidos bombardeó a los hutíes durante dos meses a principios de 2025, pero Trump suspendió esos ataques tras alcanzar un alto el fuego con el grupo y se ha mantenido al margen del conflicto desde entonces. El reciente control de los hutíes sobre el estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb amenaza con cortar la principal ruta alternativa que Riad ha utilizado para sus exportaciones de petróleo, con el fin de eludir las interrupciones en el estrecho de Ormuz. Arabia Saudita ha respondido aumentando los envíos a través de Ormuz, donde un pequeño número de petroleros realiza cada vez más viajes de ida y vuelta para sacar el petróleo con sus transpondedores apagados, cobrando tarifas récord de hasta una cuarta parte del valor de la carga por afrontar el riesgo en tiempos de guerra. A continuación, transfieren el petróleo a otros buques en el océano Índico, con destino a clientes de Asia o de otros lugares. Los datos satelitales muestran que las exportaciones saudíes a través de Ormuz han alcanzado los 2,9 millones de barriles al día en los últimos días, frente a los apenas 700.000 de agosto, lo que compensa en parte la paralización de las operaciones de carga sauditas en su puerto de Yanbu, en el mar Rojo. Esto ha contribuido a frenar el precio mundial del crudo, que ha retrocedido hasta situarse cerca de los 100 dólares por barril tras rozar los 110 dólares la semana pasada. Sin embargo, los consumidores y la industria siguen pagando precios récord por los combustibles refinados. El precio al por menor del gasóleo en Estados Unidos, un asunto políticamente delicado para Trump a seis semanas de las elecciones de mitad de legislatura, tocó el lunes otro pico, situándose por encima de los 6,51 dólares el galón. Se situaba en torno a los 3,75 dólares antes de que Trump iniciara la guerra junto a Israel en febrero. En el último ataque del que se ha tenido noticia en el estrecho de Ormuz, la agencia británica de seguridad marítima UKMTO afirmó que un buque que navegaba por el estrecho fue alcanzado por un proyectil, lo que causó heridas leves a la tripulación. La diplomacia en este conflicto más amplio se ha estancado en gran medida desde que el acuerdo provisional de junio entre Estados Unidos e Irán se viniera abajo en cuestión de semanas. El presidente de Irán, Masoud Pezeshkian, tiene previsto viajar el martes a Nueva York para asistir a la Asamblea General de la ONU, la primera visita de este tipo desde que Trump lanzó la "Operación Furia Épica" contra su país junto con Israel en febrero.

item.title: China expels two top generals from party and military, alleging disloyalty, corruption
item.description: China has expelled two top military officers, Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli, from the Communist Party and the military over "serious violations of discipline and law", the state-run Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China has expelled two top military officers, Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli, from the Communist Party and the military over "serious violations of discipline and law", the state-run Xinhua news agency said on Monday. Zhang Youxia was second-in-command under President Xi Jinping as vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission - the supreme command body - and has long been seen as Xi's closest military ally. Liu was a CMC member and the chief of staff of its Joint Staff Department. [USN:L1N3YU0TH TEXT:"The military"] has been one of the main targets of a [USN:L1N43X06G TEXT:"broader corruption crackdown"] ordered by Xi in 2012. Probes into Zhang and Liu were [USN:L1N3YP025 TEXT:"announced in January"], with the pair removed from the state Central Military Commission in [USN:L1N44P0GT TEXT:"late August"]. The Chinese leadership accused Zhang and Liu of disloyalty, corruption, dereliction of duty and other serious disciplinary violations. The pair "seriously violated political discipline and political rules, formed cliques and factions, and were disloyal and dishonest to the party," Xinhua cited official documents as saying. Zhang and Liu "crossed red lines and basic limits," it said, adding that their "political and economic wrongdoing were intertwined, and corrupt self-enrichment coexisted with dereliction of duty and abuse of office". "The sums involved were exceptionally large; the nature (of their conduct) was extremely serious and the impact extremely egregious," it said. Zhang had also been a member of the elite Politburo of the ruling Communist Party and is one of just a few leading officers with combat experience. The announcement came days before Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to travel to the US for talks with President Donald Trump, and weeks before a key October party conclave on internal party governance and discipline.

item.title: Terna, consumi elettrici in Italia ad agosto record, +16,5% su anno
item.description: Il fabbisogno di energia elettrica ad agosto ha raggiunto il valore più elevato mai registrato per questo mese, attestandosi a 28,9 TWh, in aumento del 16,5% rispetto allo stesso mese dell'anno precedente.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il fabbisogno di energia elettrica ad agosto ha raggiunto il valore più elevato mai registrato per questo mese, attestandosi a 28,9 TWh, in aumento del 16,5% rispetto allo stesso mese dell'anno precedente. Lo riporta una nota di Terna (TRN.MI) , il gestore della rete di trasmissione nazionale. A sostenere la crescita hanno contribuito in particolare le temperature eccezionalmente elevate, con una media mensile superiore di 2,6°C rispetto ad agosto 2025 e di 3°C rispetto alla media del decennio. Nelle ore notturne le temperature sono state in media superiori di 5°C rispetto allo stesso mese dello scorso anno. Al netto degli effetti di temperatura e calendario, la crescita tendenziale della domanda si attesta al 5,9%. Il dato destagionalizzato e corretto dagli effetti di calendario e temperatura mostra una crescita del 3,5% rispetto al mese di luglio 2026, quarto incremento mensile consecutivo. Nei primi otto mesi dell'anno, il fabbisogno nazionale è in crescita di 10,4 TWh (+5%) rispetto allo stesso periodo del 2025. La produzione nazionale ha coperto l'85,7% della domanda, con il restante 14,3% coperto dal saldo degli scambi con l'estero. Le fonti rinnovabili hanno coperto il 41,4% della domanda elettrica, con la generazione complessiva sostanzialmente stabile rispetto ad agosto 2025 (+0,4%). Si registra un aumento della produzione fotovoltaica (+20,4%), mentre calano eolico (-24,2%), idroelettrico (-16%), geotermico (-3,4%) e bioenergie (-3,5%).

item.title: India's infrastructure output rises 4.8% y/y in August
item.description: India's infrastructure output grew 4.8% year-on-year in August as strong cement and electricity output outweighed weakness in energy-related sectors, according to government data released on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's infrastructure output (ININFR=ECI) grew 4.8% year-on-year in August as strong cement and electricity output outweighed weakness in energy-related sectors, according to government data released on Monday. This is the third data release under the new series, which uses 2022-23 as the base year and expands the core sector basket to include iron ore. Infrastructure output had grown a revised 5% in July from a year earlier, the data showed. KEY NUMBERS • Cement output rose 12.5% in August from a revised 12.7% increase in July. • Steel production increased 3.4% last month, compared with a revised 1.9% growth in July. • Electricity generation rose 11.6% in August, as compared with a revised 8.4% increase in July. • Iron ore production rose 5.5% in August, compared with a rise of 29.5% in July. • Refinery products output rose 2.6% in August versus a revised 3% rise a month earlier. • Coal production fell 3.8% in August, compared with a rise of 7.6% the prior month. • Crude oil output fell 3.6% in August, compared with a fall of 5.3% in July. • Fertilizer production declined 12.4% in August, following an 8% contraction in the prior month. • Natural gas production shrank 4.9% in August, as compared with a revised drop of 3% in July. • The cumulative infrastructure output growth for April-August increased year-on-year to 4.3% from 2.4% in the corresponding period last year

item.title: España prorroga el contrato de De la Fuente hasta 2032 tras el triunfo en el Mundial
item.description: El seleccionador de España, Luis de la Fuente, ha firmado una ampliación de contrato de seis años que le mantendrá al frente del equipo hasta el final de la Eurocopa de 2032, tras haber llevado a la selección nacional a conquistar los títulos de la Eurocopa de 2024 y el Mundial de 2026.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Kallas
item.content:encoded: El seleccionador de España, Luis de la Fuente, ha firmado una ampliación de contrato de seis años que le mantendrá al frente del equipo hasta el final de la Eurocopa de 2032, tras haber llevado a la selección nacional a conquistar los títulos de la Eurocopa de 2024 y el Mundial de 2026. La Real Federación Española de Fútbol (RFEF) ratificó el acuerdo en una reunión del Comité Ejecutivo celebrada el lunes en Madrid, dando su aprobación formal a una renovación que ya se había acordado durante el Mundial. De la Fuente y el presidente de la RFEF, Rafael Louzan, ofrecerán una rueda de prensa más tarde este mismo lunes. Se trata del mandato más largo jamás acordado para un seleccionador de España y llevará a De la Fuente a disputar tres grandes torneos: la Eurocopa de 2028, el Mundial de 2030 y la Eurocopa de 2032, que se celebrará en Turquía e Italia. Según fuentes cercanas a la federación, el acuerdo incluye un aumento salarial considerable. Ha conseguido tres títulos para España: la Liga de Naciones, la Eurocopa y el Mundial. El único título que se le ha escapado fue la Liga de Naciones de 2025, en la que España cayó ante Portugal en la tanda de penales. De la Fuente ha dirigido 50 partidos con la selección española, con un balance de 38 victorias, 10 empates y dos derrotas. Esas derrotas se produjeron ante Escocia —su única derrota en competición oficial— y ante Colombia en un amistoso disputado en Londres. España se encuentra en su racha más larga sin conocer la derrota en la historia del fútbol internacional, con 38 partidos sin perder.

item.title: Futures in rialzo su rialzo titoli IA, prezzi greggio in calo
item.description: I futures di Wall Street sono in rialzo, trainati dal settore dell’intelligenza artificiale, mentre il calo del 2% dei prezzi del petrolio spinge al ribasso i rendimenti dei titoli del Tesoro, sulla scia dei segnali che indicano una disponibilità delle parti in conflitto in Medio Oriente a trovare una soluzione.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I futures di Wall Street sono in rialzo, trainati dal settore dell’intelligenza artificiale, mentre il calo del 2% dei prezzi del petrolio spinge al ribasso i rendimenti dei titoli del Tesoro, sulla scia dei segnali che indicano una disponibilità delle parti in conflitto in Medio Oriente a trovare una soluzione. ** Una settimana fa, le previsioni apocalittiche dei vertici delle principali società di intelligenza artificiale avevano scatenato una fuga dal settore, ma tali timori sembrano essersi dissipati, poiché gli investitori si sono concentrati sui segnali che indicano che la spesa per lo sviluppo di questa tecnologia è ancora in crescita. ** INTEL (INTC.O) balza del 5,4%, MARVELL (MRVL.O) guadagna il 2,6%, META (META.O) sale del 2,4% e DELL (DELL.N) avanza del 2,7%. ACCENTURE (ACN.N) guadagna il 6% dopo aver stretto una partnership con Anthropic per investire 2 miliardi di dollari nella valutazione dell’intelligenza artificiale. ** L’Iran e gli Stati Uniti hanno continuato a scambiarsi nuove minacce durante il fine settimana, ma il presidente Donald Trump ha detto di essere disposto a incontrare il presidente iraniano Masoud Pezeshkian, che dovrebbe trovarsi a New York questa settimana in occasione dell’Assemblea Generale delle Nazioni Unite. ** Il calo dei prezzi del greggio allenta la pressione sui titoli azionari, mentre il rendimento dei titoli di Stato statunitensi a 10 anni scende al di sotto della soglia del 5%, oggetto di grande attenzione. ** Le compagnie aeree sensibili all’andamento dei prezzi dell’energia, come DELTA (DAL.N) e AMERICAN (AAL.O) , guadagnano circa l’1% ciascuna. ** Un’impennata dell’inflazione ha spinto la Federal Reserve, la scorsa settimana, ad aumentare i tassi di interesse per la prima volta in tre anni. Secondo CME FedWatch, i mercati ritengono che ci sia una probabilità del 53% che il mese prossimo vi sia un altro rialzo dei tassi. ** Questa settimana sono in programma interventi di almeno 10 banchieri centrali, a partire da quello del presidente della Fed di Chicago Austan Goolsbee oggi, che potrebbero offrire ai trader maggiore chiarezza sulle prospettive dei tassi. ** Alle ore 11.35 italiane, i Dow E-mini scambiano in rialzo di 311 punti, pari allo 0,6%, mentre gli S&P 500 E-mini guadagnano 50 punti, pari allo 0,7%. I Nasdaq 100 E-mini scambiano in rialzo di 343,5 punti, o dell’1,2%. ** Giovedì l’attenzione sarà concentrata sulla diplomazia in occasione di un vertice Cina-Usa che potrebbe vertere su argomenti quali la proroga della tregua commerciale tra le due superpotenze, la guerra in Iran e la regolamentazione sui progressi nell’intelligenza artificiale. ** WARNER BROS (WBD.O) balza del 7,6% dopo indiscrezioni stampa secondo cui PARAMOUNT (PSKY.O) e il procuratore generale della California avrebbero discusso alcune concessioni nell’ambito di trattative avanzate per un accordo che potrebbero contribuire a concludere la fusione proposta tra le due società.

item.title: La UE exigirá a los centros de datos que divulguen su eficiencia energética e hídrica
item.description: La Comisión Europea propuso el lunes una normativa que obliga a los centros de datos de Europa a revelar la eficiencia con la que utilizan la energía y el agua, ante la creciente preocupación por su consumo de recursos.
item.dc:creator: Kate Abnett
item.content:encoded: La Comisión Europea propuso el lunes una normativa que obliga a los centros de datos de Europa a revelar la eficiencia con la que utilizan la energía y el agua, ante la creciente preocupación por su consumo de recursos. La UE quiere triplicar la capacidad de sus centros de datos en los próximos siete años, con el fin de apoyar el rápido desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial e intentar reducir la dependencia de las grandes empresas tecnológicas estadounidenses. Esto podría suponer una sobrecarga para las redes eléctricas europeas, el agotamiento de los recursos hídricos y un aumento de las emisiones de CO2, si no se controla el consumo de energía y agua de estas enormes instalaciones. Con el fin de incentivar a las empresas a construir centros de datos más eficientes desde el punto de vista energético e hídrico, la Comisión ha propuesto un sistema de clasificación de las instalaciones para que esta información sea más transparente. El sistema no impondría límites a su consumo de energía y agua ni exigiría a los centros de datos que revelaran su consumo total de energía, pero sí obligaría a los operadores de instalaciones con una capacidad de 500 kW a dar a conocer su eficiencia energética e hídrica mediante un sistema de etiquetado diseñado por la UE. Los centros de datos también tendrían que divulgar información sobre la relación entre su consumo de agua y los niveles de estrés hídrico en la zona, así como sobre su capacidad para prestar servicios al sistema energético local, por ejemplo, mediante la reutilización de su calor residual. La nueva etiqueta podría servir de precursor a unas normas mínimas obligatorias sobre la eficiencia hídrica y energética de los centros de datos en Europa, que la UE está elaborando. Actualmente, los centros de datos representan alrededor del 2,5% del consumo eléctrico de la UE, según indicó la UE en un informe publicado en junio. Se prevé que esa proporción aumente, ya que se espera que la capacidad de los centros de datos de la UE se duplique con creces para 2030, hasta alcanzar los 28 gigavatios, frente a los 12 GW del año pasado. Los países de la UE y los legisladores disponen de dos meses para oponerse a las normas. De lo contrario, entrarán en vigor.

item.title: Swiss business groups pressure parliament over UBS capital rules before vote
item.description: Swiss business groups have weighed into the debate on tougher capital rules for UBS , writing to lawmakers to lobby against what they say risks being "excessive" regulation drawn up for the bank after the 2023 collapse of Credit Suisse.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swiss business groups have weighed into the debate on tougher capital rules for UBS , writing to lawmakers to lobby against what they say risks being "excessive" regulation drawn up for the bank after the 2023 collapse of Credit Suisse. The heads of top business lobby economiesuisse, and bodies for SMEs, manufacturers, multinationals and pharma companies, said the government's proposals would massively disadvantage UBS against international rivals by ramping up capital costs. "Such excessive regulatory requirements would not only affect the banks themselves," the signatories wrote to upper house lawmakers in a letter dated September 18 seen by Reuters. "In the long term, they would also be reflected in higher financing costs and a reduced supply of credit and capital market services for industry for our SMEs," they added. The government, which says stricter regulations are needed to strengthen banks and protect taxpayers from the risk of another banking meltdown, calculates its entire package of measures would mean UBS holding another $20 billion in capital. Lawmakers are deciding between the government's demand that UBS back its foreign units with 100% Common Equity Tier 1 capital, a proposal for 90% CET1 backing and a softer compromise for backing of 50% CET1 and 50% cheaper Additional Tier 1 bonds. Both UBS CEO Sergio [USN:L1N45C05I TEXT:"Ermotti"] and Chairman Colm [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"Kelleher"] have in the past few days urged lawmakers to avoid imposing excessively harsh rules on the bank, saying that while the 50% AT1 option would be painful, it would be manageable. UBS calculates the AT1 option would mean finding another $13 billion in capital. The letter is the latest lobbying push and comes as the upper house prepares to vote on reform proposals on [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"Wednesday"]. The associations urged lawmakers to back the 50% AT1 capital compromise, saying the other two were too stringent. "This strengthens systemic stability without weakening the financial centre or unnecessarily worsening financing conditions for companies," the letter said.

item.title: How one millennial is building wealth by buying assets, not stuff
item.description: As more and more young people opt to buy second-hand, some are figuring out how to turn reselling into a source of income.
item.dc:creator: Hani Richter
item.content:encoded: Dandan Zhu. Courtesy Dandan Zhu/Handout via REUTERS When Dandan Zhu purchased a Rolex in 2012 for $2,400, she didn’t just treat it like a luxury watch —she saw it as an asset. Years later, that investment paid off. When her tenants failed to pay rent on time, Zhu sold the Rolex and broke even, giving her a quick influx of cash to cover her mortgage. “I deeply understand retail arbitrage,” the New York-based 38-year-old says, referring to the practice of reselling goods for a profit. As a university student, she sold gaming consoles on eBay to help pay off her tuition. Even after graduating in the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis and landing her first job in recruitment, she continued buying and reselling goods to supplement her income, eventually climbing the career ladder and purchasing her first home in 2014. Nowadays, the former headhunter-turned-content creator trades primarily in limited-edition luxury bags that she knows will retain value and, if needed, generate income. “I specifically know specific products I can guarantee a $2,000 profit,” she says, noting that while basic bags will depreciate in value, "the ones that will appreciate are those (that are) very special.” Dandan Zhu. Courtesy Dandan Zhu/Handout via REUTERS While she researches products online and in-store, Zhu says she also relies on AI to help her identify which items are likely to appreciate in value in the longterm. THE WIDER TREND A 2026 ThredUp and GlobalData Resale Report found that more than half of Gen Z and millennial consumers browse or prioritize second-hand purchases before buying new. Cory Christiana, a Boston-based certified financial planner and investment adviser at NEXTEN FP, sees this trend as generational. “Each generation sees what the generation did before and tends to set their own path,” he says, noting that while boomers accumulated homes and financial assets, younger generations, facing affordability challenges and lives increasingly lived online, may be drawn towards more physical assets. “It’s important to slow down and ask yourself if there is real value in a purchase or if it's something you want,” he says. “The distinction is an important one.” Historically, certain jewelry, collectible cars, and artwork have retained and grown in value over time. But Christiana emphasizes that these kinds of assets work best as additions to a diversified portfolio — including stocks, bonds, real estate and cash — rather than as a replacement for them. KEY TAKEAWAYS A luxury item can function as emergency liquidity. When Zhu's tenants stopped paying rent and she had little working capital, the Rolex she sold gave her something she could convert into cash when she needed it. Research before buying. Check realistic resale prices and total transaction costs before treating a purchase as an asset. It’s important to note that an item only qualifies as an asset if it is rare and other people are willing to pay for it. A limited-edition watch or handbag fits this criterion; mass-produced goods for fast fashion, however, typically do not. Investing in assets works well within a diverse financial plan. Treat resalable assets as an addition to a wider portfolio of investments, not a replacement. Have a money lesson or story to share? Tell us what worked for you — or what didn’t — by emailing hani.richter@tr.com .

item.title: Swiss captain Xhaka sidelined over fake COVID certificate
item.description: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka will miss the international camp after admitting he acquired a fake COVID-19 vaccination certificate, the Swiss Football Association (SFV) said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka will miss the international camp after admitting he acquired a fake COVID-19 vaccination certificate, the Swiss Football Association (SFV) said on Monday. The decision was reached jointly by the player and SFV leadership after Xhaka issued a public statement acknowledging his actions. "In this agitated emotional state, I acquired a vaccination certificate instead of clarifying my open questions through the intended path," Xhaka wrote in a statement on social media. "Today I see clearly that this path was not right. It was a mistake. I am sorry." Xhaka, 33, added that he was cooperating fully with the relevant authorities. The midfielder, who plays for Sunderland in the Premier League, made his international debut in 2011 and is Switzerland's all-time record appearance holder with 152 caps. SFV President Peter Knaebel welcomed Xhaka’s willingness to take responsibility. "Granit Xhaka informed us about the situation yesterday evening and told us at the same time that he would comment publicly on it and take responsibility," Knaebel said in a statement. "We welcome Granit taking this step. At the same time, we came to the joint conclusion that it is in the best interest of the team to complete this gathering without him." Knaebel added that the focus must shift to maintaining calm ahead of the team's UEFA Nations League fixtures. Switzerland gathered in Belek, Turkey, on Monday to prepare for away matches against North Macedonia and Scotland, followed by home games against Slovenia and North Macedonia. The SFV said it will reassess the situation with Xhaka after the conclusion of the international window.

item.title: Cobre sube a medida que expectativas sobre demanda china se suman al impulso especulativo
item.description: Los precios del cobre subían el lunes por quinta sesión consecutiva, acercándose a máximos históricos, ya que las expectativas de un repunte estacional de la demanda en China —el mayor consumidor mundial— mantenían las compras especulativas.
item.dc:creator: Polina Devitt
item.content:encoded: Los precios del cobre subían el lunes por quinta sesión consecutiva, acercándose a máximos históricos, ya que las expectativas de un repunte estacional de la demanda en China —el mayor consumidor mundial— mantenían las compras especulativas. * El contrato de referencia del cobre a tres meses en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME) subía un 0,9% a 14.654 dólares por tonelada a las 0957 GMT, tras alcanzar los 14.710,5 dólares, su nivel más alto desde el 10 de septiembre, cuando tocó un máximo de 14.875 dólares. * La renovada demanda especulativa ha impulsado al alza el precio del cobre después de que los fondos redujeran sus posiciones largas netas en los futuros del cobre de la Comex en la semana que finalizó el 15 de septiembre, ya que la Casa Blanca aún no se ha pronunciado sobre los aranceles al cobre refinado, según explicó Ole Hansen, responsable de estrategia de materias primas de Saxo Bank. * La prima de los futuros del cobre de Estados Unidos sobre los precios de la LME se amplió, pero siguió siendo insuficiente para fomentar nuevos envíos físicos a las existencias de cobre de la COMEX , que almacenan el 69% de los 1 millón de toneladas de existencias de cobre supervisadas por la bolsa. * Las expectativas de reposición de existencias en China antes de las vacaciones nacionales del 25 de septiembre y del 1 al 7 de octubre sirvieron de apoyo a los precios del cobre, mientras los operadores esperan la reunión de esta semana entre el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, y el líder chino, Xi Jinping. * El índice del cobre de Yangshan , un indicador de la demanda china de cobre importado, cerró la semana pasada en 124 dólares por tonelada, su nivel más alto en casi cuatro años, aunque el lunes bajó a 119 dólares. * Las existencias de cobre disponibles en los almacenes registrados en la LME cayeron hasta las 133.725 toneladas, según mostraron los datos diarios de la LME, tras registrarse 9.600 toneladas de nuevas cancelaciones en Asia. * Esto contribuyó a ampliar la prima del contrato al contado de cobre de la LME sobre el índice de referencia hasta los 26 dólares por tonelada, frente al descuento de 86 dólares registrado el 14 de septiembre. * Entre los metales de la LME, el aluminio y el zinc caían 0,1%, hasta situarse en 3.286 y 3.917 dólares, respectivamente. El plomo subía 0,3% a 1.927 dólares, tras alcanzar su máximo de tres meses en 1.929,5 dólares; el estaño ganaba 0,3% a 53.610 dólares y el níquel avanzaba 0,5% a 16.270 dólares.

item.title: India's SP Group bonds offered at premium on Tata Sons stake-sale plan, bankers say
item.description: Deutsche Bank and other investors are offering rupee-denominated bonds of a Shapoorji Pallonji Group firm at a premium, encouraged by the group's plans to sell part of its stake in Tata Sons, three merchant bankers said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia, Khushi Malhotra
item.content:encoded: Deutsche Bank and other investors are offering rupee-denominated bonds of a Shapoorji Pallonji Group firm at a premium, encouraged by the group's [USN:L4N4591AA TEXT:"plans"] to sell part of its stake in Tata Sons, three merchant bankers said on Monday. Tata Trusts, the controlling shareholder in Tata Sons, last week said SP Group proposed to sell part of its stake worth 250 billion rupees ($2.61 billion). That would give much-needed funds to the debt-laden infrastructure and construction conglomerate, the second-largest shareholder in Tata Sons. SP Group entity [USN:L4N43J0Q9 TEXT:"Eqyizen Investment"] had raised 213.50 billion rupees through three-year zero-coupon bonds at a yield of 18.95% in July. The bonds are now being offered at a yield of around 18.70%-18.75%, the bankers said, requesting anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to the media. Eqyizen's bonds are secured by SP Group's stake in Tata Sons, held through Cyrus Investments. SP Group and Deutsche Bank, which structured the bond sale and was also a large investor in the issue, did not respond to Reuters requests for comment. "Deutsche Bank has the bonds on its books and is actively seeking buyers to exit at some profit," one of the bankers said. "We have not seen major trades (yet)." The 160-year-old SP Group has more than 500 billion rupees of high-interest debt outstanding and due for redemption in the next few years. Another one of its entities, Porteast Investment, has outstanding zero-coupon bonds worth 286 billion rupees. SP Group is also planning to seek an extension to a payment worth around 35 billion rupees, which is due on September 30, towards an obligation of Porteast, the bankers added. ($1 = 95.8150 Indian rupees)

item.title: Chess-CAS ruling on Russia a red line for FIDE, says presidential candidate Turlov
item.description: FIDE presidential candidate Timur Turlov said the world chess body must continue to abide by international sports rulings restricting Russian participation, while expressing hope that Russian federations will eventually meet the conditions required for a return to full competition.
item.dc:creator: Karan Prashant Saxena
item.content:encoded: FIDE presidential candidate Timur Turlov said the world chess body must continue to abide by international sports rulings restricting Russian participation, while expressing hope that Russian federations will eventually meet the conditions required for a return to full competition. The September 26 election will be held during FIDE's General Assembly in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, with the Kazakh businessman facing German entrepreneurs Wadim Rosenstein and Jan Henric Buettner. The issue regarding Russian players has remained central in the presidential race following the decision of incumbent Arkady Dvorkovich , a former Russian deputy prime minister, not to seek re-election after being included in a European Union sanctions package. Turlov was originally part of Dvorkovich's presidential team before launching his own bid. "I respect Arkady very much and I truly believe that he did a great job for FIDE," Turlov told Reuters on a video call. "But I am too independent to be someone else's shadow." Turlov renounced his Russian citizenship and became a Kazakh citizen in 2022, while his Freedom Holding Corp group has sought to distance itself from Russia-related business activities. He and the company were sanctioned by Ukraine the same year, measures he has repeatedly challenged. He said any administration under his leadership would continue to abide by rulings issued by the[USN:L1N42J0C4 TEXT:" Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS)"], which prevent Russian teams from competing in FIDE events. "We will follow this CAS ruling because we have to be compliant with the Olympic movement," Turlov said. "If we are excluded from the Olympic movement because of disrespect to CAS decisions, that will hurt the chess movement very much." TALENTED PLAYERS Turlov expressed hopes the Russian federation would meet the requirements needed to return to international competition, arguing the sport was losing access to a generation of talented players. The businessman also addressed questions surrounding Ukrainian sanctions against him, saying he should be judged on his record and vision rather than political narratives. "I think the best way to address concerns about Ukrainian sanctions is to team up with the Ukrainian team in some way," he said. "I want to reunite FIDE as much as I can to get different representations." The election campaign has also been overshadowed by complaints over visa delays affecting delegates and officials travelling to the Chess Olympiad and FIDE Congress. Turlov said he had raised concerns with organisers. "We need as fair an election as possible and to have as much representation as possible," he said. "It's important not to influence the election, intentionally or unintentionally." Beyond politics, Turlov said he would focus on expanding chess's digital reach, supporting smaller federations and attracting new audiences through greater investment in online infrastructure, artificial intelligence and anti-cheating technology.

item.title: Presley Gerber, filho de Cindy Crawford, morre aos 27 anos
item.description: Presley Gerber, filho da supermodelo Cindy Crawford, morreu no domingo aos 27 anos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Presley Gerber, filho da supermodelo Cindy Crawford, morreu no domingo aos 27 anos. O instituto médico legal de Los Angeles indicou em seu relatório que ele faleceu em uma clínica de reabilitação, sem informar a causa da morte. Gerber era o filho mais velho de Crawford e do empresário Rande Gerber e trabalhava como modelo. Seu trabalho na área da moda incluiu campanhas e desfiles para marcas como Calvin Klein e Dolce & Gabbana. Em 2018, ele apareceu ao lado de sua mãe no comercial da Pepsi para o Super Bowl LII. Ele chegou a falar abertamente sobre suas dificuldades com a saúde mental. Em uma postagem no Instagram em novembro do ano passado, ele disse que havia iniciado uma série chamada “Segundas-feiras de saúde mental”, afirmando que “o objetivo era estimular conversas reais sobre as coisas que a maioria das pessoas esconde”. Em agosto, sua irmã Kaia Gerber, que também é modelo, falou sobre as dificuldades do irmão em uma entrevista à revista Vogue, dizendo: “Quando algo assim acontece em uma família, isso meio que afeta a todos”, afirmou ela.

item.title: Spain extend De la Fuente contract until 2032 after World Cup triumph
item.description: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has signed a six-year contract extension that will keep him in charge until the end of the 2032 European Championship, after leading the national team to the 2024 European Championship and 2026 World Cup titles.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Kallas
item.content:encoded: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has signed a six-year contract extension that will keep him in charge until the end of the 2032 European Championship, after leading the national team to the 2024 European Championship and 2026 World Cup titles. The Spanish FA (RFEF) ratified the agreement at an Executive Committee meeting in Madrid on Monday, giving formal approval to a renewal that had been agreed during the World Cup. De la Fuente and the RFEF president Rafael Louzan will hold a press conference later on Monday. It is the longest tenure ever agreed for a Spain head coach and takes De la Fuente through three major tournaments: the 2028 European Championship, the 2030 World Cup and the 2032 European Championship in Turkey and Italy. According to sources close to the federation, the deal includes a considerable pay rise. He has delivered three trophies for Spain: the Nations League, the European Championship and the World Cup. The only title to elude him was the 2025 Nations League, which Spain lost to Portugal on penalties. De la Fuente has managed 50 Spain matches, with his record standing at 38 wins, 10 draws and two defeats. Those losses came against Scotland, his only competitive defeat, and Colombia in a friendly in London. Spain are on their longest unbeaten run in international football history, going 38 matches without defeat.

item.title: Los alumnos de Gaza vuelven a las clases presenciales por primera vez en tres años
item.description: Cientos de miles de niños de Gaza volvieron el sábado a las clases presenciales por primera vez en casi tres años, aunque en edificios escolares dañados o improvisados y en tiendas de campaña, y con uniformes, cuadernos y bolígrafos que muchas familias no pueden permitirse.
item.dc:creator: Nidal Al-Mughrabi, Haseeb Alwazeer
item.content:encoded: Cientos de miles de niños de Gaza volvieron el sábado a las clases presenciales por primera vez en casi tres años, aunque en edificios escolares dañados o improvisados y en tiendas de campaña, y con uniformes, cuadernos y bolígrafos que muchas familias no pueden permitirse. El Fondo de las Naciones Unidas para la Infancia (UNICEF) afirma que el 98% de las escuelas de Gaza quedaron destruidas o dañadas durante la guerra, y las autoridades educativas de Gaza señalan que unos 660.000 alumnos se han visto privados de la enseñanza presencial y de la participación regular en el sistema educativo. La reapertura supone un hito frágil para Gaza tras un conflicto que se ha cobrado la vida de unos 22.000 estudiantes y más de 770 trabajadores del sector educativo, entre ellos 532 profesores, según Ibrahim Ramadan, director de Educación de Jan Yunis Este. "La última vez que fui al colegio fue hace tres años. Ahora comenzamos el curso escolar, es un año de alegría, felicidad y éxito", dijo Moayed Abu Mustafa en Jan Yunis. Mustafa afirmó que estaba decidido a aprender aunque tenga que sentarse en el suelo de una tienda de campaña sin ventilación, no tenga unos zapatos decentes, ni cuaderno ni bolígrafo, y haya perdido a amigos durante la guerra. "A pesar de todo esto, aprenderemos, aprenderemos incluso en una tienda de campaña." Samar Abu Salmi, una estudiante desplazada de quince años que vive con su familia en una tienda de campaña, también vuelve a clase. "Estudiábamos con el móvil y no habíamos visto a nuestros profesores (…). Ahora, volvemos a perseguir nuestro sueño (…) de una tienda de campaña a otra", dijo, hablando en el patio de su nueva escuela improvisada. Además, carece de gran parte del material escolar básico, que se ha vuelto inasequible para su familia. "Antes de la guerra, teníamos todo a nuestro alcance: cuadernos, bolígrafos, artículos de primera necesidad, ropa, excursiones (…), cosas que podíamos conseguir a buen precio", explicó Salmi. COLCHONES Y UNA PIZARRA A pesar de la devastación en el enclave, el Ministerio de Educación, con el respaldo de organizaciones internacionales y locales, ha seguido adelante con el curso académico 2026-27, creando decenas de escuelas provisionales hechas con tiendas de campaña, lonas, chapas y madera para acoger a los alumnos. Algunas están construidas sobre terreno arenoso, otras cuentan con aulas en las que solo hay unos colchones y una pizarra, en las que los alumnos se apiñan. Otras siguen albergando a decenas de familias desplazadas. En otra de estas escuelas asistía Yamen Abu Samra, de 14 años. "Antes nos despertábamos contentos de ir al colegio (…). Ahora, cuando venimos al colegio, tenemos miedo de las balas perdidas, los cohetes, los bombardeos, de todo", dijo. "Ahora estoy en una tienda de campaña que no tiene absolutamente nada, solo el sol y el calor", añadió. Se espera que al menos 540.000 alumnos asistan este año a clases presenciales en escuelas privadas improvisadas, centros de aprendizaje temporales y puntos educativos, con el apoyo de UNICEF, según fuentes del Ministerio de Educación. La enseñanza en línea continuará para aquellos que no puedan asistir a clase o que abandonaron Gaza durante la guerra. Las fuerzas israelíes siguen controlando más del 60% de Gaza a pesar del alto el fuego del año pasado, que detuvo los principales combates pero no logró poner fin al conflicto. Las autoridades palestinas afirman que más de 73.000 personas han perdido la vida en la ofensiva israelí contra Gaza, lanzada después de que combatientes liderados por Hamás mataran a unas 1.200 personas en el sur de Israel en octubre de 2023. Jaled Aliyan, de 30 años, comerciante de material de papelería, dijo que las restricciones israelíes a las importaciones han reducido el suministro y disparado los precios. "Este cuaderno, que antes costaba 3 séqueles (1 dólar), ahora cuesta 15 (séqueles). Todos los artículos de papelería son caros", dijo. La agencia militar israelí COGAT, que controla el acceso a Gaza, no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters sobre las restricciones al suministro y los ataques contra escuelas. Israel ha acusado en repetidas ocasiones a Hamás de utilizar escuelas con fines militares, algo que Hamás niega. (1 dólar = 3,0177 shekels)

item.title: Ações da Volkswagen e da Porsche ampliam quedas após alerta sobre lucros
item.description: As ações da Volkswagen , maior montadora da Europa, continuavam em queda nesta segunda-feira, após um alerta sobre os lucros que incluiu uma baixa contábil de 6 bilhões de euros (US$6,88 bilhões) no ágio da divisão de carros esportivos de luxo Porsche .

item.content:encoded: As ações da Volkswagen , maior montadora da Europa, continuavam em queda nesta segunda-feira, após um alerta sobre os lucros que incluiu uma baixa contábil de 6 bilhões de euros (US$6,88 bilhões) no ágio da divisão de carros esportivos de luxo Porsche (P911_p.DE) . Na sexta-feira, a Volkswagen reduziu sua previsão de margem de lucro para 2026 para, no máximo, 1%, ante uma faixa anterior de 4% a 5,5%, atribuindo a queda à desaceleração do mercado chinês, ao aumento das provisões para aposentadorias e à situação crítica da Porsche. item.title: Mombak anuncia novo fundo e passa a contar com Salesforce como compradora de créditos de carbono
item.description: A startup brasileira de remoção de carbono Mombak anunciou nesta segunda-feira que concluiu o primeiro fechamento de seu segundo fundo de reflorestamento e assinou um novo contrato de compra antecipada de créditos de carbono com a Salesforce , ao mesmo tempo em que aposta que a demanda se expandirá para além das empresas de tecnologia que ajudaram a construir o mercado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A startup brasileira de remoção de carbono Mombak anunciou nesta segunda-feira que concluiu o primeiro fechamento de seu segundo fundo de reflorestamento e assinou um novo contrato de compra antecipada de créditos de carbono com a Salesforce (CRM.N) , ao mesmo tempo em que aposta que a demanda se expandirá para além das empresas de tecnologia que ajudaram a construir o mercado. A empresa informou que o "The Amazon Reforestation Fund II" tem como meta arrecadar US$150 milhões para financiar projetos de restauração na Amazônia brasileira e terá acesso a uma linha de crédito de R$200 milhões do Fundo Clima, operado pelo BNDES (BNDES.UL). Os investidores estão de olho nas tendências de demanda no mercado emergente de remoção de carbono, onde empresas como Google (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) e Meta (META.O) surgiram como grandes compradoras, à medida que buscam lidar com as emissões ligadas à rápida expansão da infraestrutura de IA. "A gente só está conseguindo fazer a captação desse segundo fundo porque a gente conseguiu provar ao longo desses últimos cinco anos que existe um business, existe uma indústria. Esse produto que a gente se propôs a criar, essa solução, tem um mercado para ela”, disse o presidente-executivo da Mombak, Gabriel Silva, à Reuters. O primeiro fundo da Mombak arrecadou US$120 milhões de investidores, incluindo um fundo da AXA (AXAF.PA) , a CPP Investments e a Bain Capital, financiando projetos de restauração em 15 fazendas na Amazônia, onde a empresa plantou quase 15 milhões de árvores nativas. A empresa também anunciou um contrato plurianual de compra de créditos de remoção de carbono com a Salesforce, adicionando a empresa de software a uma lista de compradores que já inclui Google, Microsoft e McLaren Racing. O acordo segue a primeira emissão de créditos de remoção de carbono por reflorestamento da Mombak, realizada no início deste ano. A empresa espera uma segunda emissão, maior, de aproximadamente 80 mil toneladas métricas até o final de 2026. SURGIMENTO DE NOVOS COMPRADORES Embora as grandes empresas de tecnologia tenham ajudado a estabelecer o mercado para remoções de carbono de alta qualidade, tanto a Mombak quanto o BNDES esperam que a demanda se expanda para novos setores. “Ao longo do tempo, eu acho que você pode até esperar que a gente volte com anúncios de empresas que não são essas big techs", disse Silva, acrescentando que ganhos de produtividade e técnicas aprimoradas de reflorestamento estão reduzindo os custos e tornando os créditos acessíveis a uma gama mais ampla de compradores. A diretora socioambiental do BNDES, Tereza Campello, disse que as empresas de tecnologia estão reavaliando suas metas climáticas à medida que os custos associados a data centers com alto consumo de energia ficam mais claros, enquanto o interesse de setores como petróleo, mineração e siderurgia se intensificou. "A gente tem sido procurado por outros setores que não estavam com tanto apetite para a área de crédito de carbono, que têm se mostrado muito interessados", disse ela. Os créditos de carbono permitem que as empresas compensem as emissões de gases de efeito estufa por meio do financiamento de atividades que reduzam ou removam emissões em outros locais. (Reportagem de Gabriel Araujo)

item.title: Partido pró-Putin vence eleição russa em tempo de guerra com mais de 57% dos votos, segundo apuração
item.description: O partido governista Rússia Unida venceu com facilidade as eleições parlamentares que o presidente Vladimir Putin apresentou como um teste de apoio à guerra na Ucrânia, informou a Comissão Eleitoral Central nesta segunda-feira, após a apuração de mais de 95% dos votos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O partido governista Rússia Unida venceu com facilidade as eleições parlamentares que o presidente Vladimir Putin apresentou como um teste de apoio à guerra na Ucrânia, informou a Comissão Eleitoral Central nesta segunda-feira, após a apuração de mais de 95% dos votos. O partido Rússia Unida obteve 57,83% dos votos, segundo a Comissão Eleitoral Central, um aumento em relação aos 49,8% conquistados em 2021, quando foram realizadas as últimas eleições para a Duma Estatal, a câmara baixa do Parlamento.
